description: This PHP source file provides localization and internationalization functions for the TestLink project, including string retrieval, language loading, and date/time formatting.

methods.name: lang_get
methods.description: Retrieves an internationalized string based on user preference or defaults, with fallback to English and charset conversion.

methods.name: langGetFormated
methods.description: Retrieves a localized string and inserts a modifier into it.

methods.name: lang_get_smarty
methods.description: Fetches localized strings for Smarty templates, either as a variable or direct return.

methods.name: lang_load
methods.description: Loads language strings from files into the global $g_lang_strings array.

methods.name: lang_ensure_loaded
methods.description: Ensures a language is loaded, calling lang_load if necessary.

methods.name: localize_array
methods.description: Localizes each string in an array of string keys.

methods.name: init_labels
methods.description: Translates a map of codes to localized labels.

methods.name: localize_date_smarty
methods.description: Adds a localized date to Smarty template.

methods.name: localize_timestamp_smarty
methods.description: Adds a localized timestamp to Smarty template.

methods.name: localize_dateOrTimeStamp
methods.description: Formats a date or timestamp into a localized string.

methods.name: localizeTimeStamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a localized string.

methods.name: mailBodyGet
methods.description: Retrieves email body templates based on locale and key.
